# kr8tiv AI

> kr8tiv AI is a professional AI automation company. We build AI back-office and operations systems for businesses — receipt pipelines, same-day quoting with profitability checks, dispatch tracking, 6:30 AM operational digests, and MCP-native watchdog agents — wired into the tools a business already uses (spreadsheets, drive, email). Fixed-scope engagements; the source code for everything we build for a client is handed over to that client. Based in Edmonton, Alberta; working everywhere.

Contact: hello@kr8tiv.ai · +1-780-915-5471 · intake at https://kr8tiv.io/start/

## What we build

- AI Ops Audit: one week inside an operation, mapping where the hours go; deliverable is a written automation plan the client keeps either way.
- Back-Office Build: agents wired into the client's existing stack — automated receipt filing (photo → logged expense), quoting engines with break-even checks, dispatch from lead to invoice, morning digests, watchdog agents that flag unpaid invoices and unscheduled deposits.
- Care: ongoing tuning and new automations, month to month. No lock-in — the client owns the data, the documents, and the source code we wrote for them.

## Proof

- Case study: Evolve Eco Blasting (Edmonton industrial surface restoration, https://evolveecoblasting.com) — one crew, zero office staff. kr8tiv AI built their complete operations layer on the spreadsheets and drive they already owned. Nothing was replaced. Full write-up: https://kr8tiv.ai/work/evolve/

## Products

- JARVIS — the context engine behind every build: one place that holds what a business knows, so each agent acts on current facts instead of guessing. https://kr8tiv.ai/jarvis/
- KIN — the AI front desk: a bespoke assistant on voice, Telegram, and WhatsApp, configured end to end for non-technical staff. https://kr8tiv.ai/kin/
